never: give a caller an arrival time the job does not hold
write a new job for a caller who already has an open one
tell a caller they are booked when the write came back with no id
leave a caller on hold or drop them when a transfer is not picked up
send a status message without a change in the job system behind it, twice for one change, or to anyone but the job's contact
message a contact who has not agreed to messages
stand up telephony, disclosure or recording of your own
stays_with_person: every transfer once it is answered
every callback, by the person the roster names
anything said to an upset customer
moving the arrival time on the board

provider_block.job: the phone answered in business hours and the customer kept told, from the job record

checks.title: Disclosure first, on every daytime call
The caller is looked up before anything is written, and an existing job is worked on, not duplicated
New work is written the way Booked After Hours writes it
A status question is answered from the job, or not answered
A caller who asks for a person is put through, and a missed transfer becomes a callback with a name and a time
Running late, on the way and job complete are sent only when the record changes
One message per change, and a new change gets a new message
An update goes only to the contact on the job, and only with their consent
Every call and every update is written back to the job
A job write with no id back is not a booked job
